meaning:
1) to draw, dangle
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to draw
1a2) drawing advice (fig.)
1b) (Piel) to draw up

renderings.kjv: for thou hast lifted me up

elsewhere.note: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
